title: dsh-verified-plugins report front-matter
description: Flat YAML front-matter contract for reports/<plugin>/report.md. Deliberately flat so it can be validated by a zero-dependency validator. The body is free-form Markdown governed by docs/method.md.

plugin.description: Exact npm package name, including scope when present.

version.description: Exact resolved version. Never a range, tag, or branch.

source.description: Where the audited artifact came from (registry page, repository, or tarball URL).

integrity.description: Integrity hash actually resolved at install time, not the value advertised by the registry.

dsh_runtime.description: Exact DSH runtime version the tiers ran against.

os.description: OS and architecture, e.g. macos-15-arm64 or ubuntu-24.04-x64.

date.description: Date the tiers were executed, ISO 8601.

verdict.description: Highest tier that actually executed, or an outcome code. See docs/method.md.

author_disclosure.description: "true" when the reporter is an author or contributor of the plugin.

tier.description: Outcome of one tier. A tier that did not execute is "skip", and the verdict may not exceed it.
